name: Nirvana Pilot Yume
source:
Win back your place among the best pilots of Alba Proxima and find the love you have lost! Help Yume, a young girl dreaming to become a Nirvana Pilot, to master the incredible speed of the Ultra-Engine and make choices during the story events.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/716680/Nirvana_Pilot_Yume/] Steam[/url]]
translation:
重新赢得阿尔巴比邻星最优秀飞行员的位置，并找到你失去的爱！帮助梦想成为Nirvana飞行员的年轻女孩Yume掌握超级引擎的惊人速度，并在故事事件中做出选择。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/716680/Nirvana_Pilot_Yume/] Steam[/url]]
